name: Eidos CLI (eidos-ai)
description: Installs the Eidos Git-native living specification & AI architecture orchestrator CLI (eidos-ai) via uv.

version.description: Version of eidos-ai to install from PyPI (or 'latest').

semantic.description: Install optional local Harrier ONNX Hybrid RRF semantic search dependencies (eidos-ai[semantic]).

pythonVersion.description: Python version for uv to use when provisioning the isolated Eidos tool environment (3.11-3.14 required when semantic=true).
